guidance.statement: Double-digit growth expected for next 5-10 years across markets
guidance.quote: we believe the growth should continue in double-digits for the next 5-10 years at least

guidance.statement: India CAPEX to be Rs. 500-600 crore; low due to adequate capacity
guidance.quote: Our CAPEX will be less than Rs. 500 crore - Rs. 600 crore this year for India

guidance.statement: Target ~500,000 new outlet additions on 4 million base in 2026
guidance.quote: we are hoping to add close to half a million outlets with a base of about 4 million

guidance.statement: Existing capacity sufficient for 50% volume growth without additions
guidance.quote: even if we get a 50% growth, we can comfortably do it without adding any capacity

guidance.statement: New plants to deliver 3-4 year payback with 30% ROCE
guidance.quote: Normally we work on a 3-4 year payback. 30% RoCE

guidance.statement: Fully covered for Q2 CY2026; partially covered for Q3 in India
guidance.quote: We are completely covered for this quarter, and we are partly covered for the next quarter also

delivered.statement: Revenue grew 18.1% YoY to Rs. 65,742 million in Q1
Consolidated volumes grew 16.3% YoY to 363.4 million cases
EBITDA increased 21% YoY to Rs. 15,289 million; margins up 55 bps
PAT grew 20.1% YoY to Rs. 8,787 million in Q1 2026
Low-sugar and no-sugar products now 63% of consolidated sales volume
Completed Twizza acquisition (revenue ~Rs. 800 cr); signed Crickley Dairy agreement
Dairy growing 60-70%; Sting Classic launched with strong response
Interim dividend of Rs. 0.50 per share (25% of face value) approved

themes: Strong demand: volumes +16.3%, driven by favorable weather and distribution expansion
Input cost inflation hedged with 6-month inventory; managed via discount reduction
Healthier product premiumization: 63% low/no-sugar mix; dairy at 3x realization
Africa growth via Twizza and Crickley Dairy acquisitions for manufacturing footprint
Manufacturing efficiency: newer larger plants reduce unit costs vs. older facilities
Distribution infrastructure: target half-million new outlets; half-million chilling units market-wide
risks: Geopolitical uncertainty driving crude oil, PET, and transportation cost inflation
Monsoon/weather dependency for consumer demand, particularly in summer season
Aluminum can shortages and rising raw material costs affecting margins
Competitive intensity from new entrants (Campa) and established players (Coke)

analyst_pushback.topic: Input cost inflation impact on margins
analyst_pushback.response: 6-month inventory coverage in intl, reasonable cover in India; competitors worse-positioned; we won't blink first
Premiumized products; dairy segment growing 60% at 3x normal realization offset pack upsizing impact
Cans <2% of volume; well-supplied; customers switch to PET when cans unavailable

analyst_pushback.topic: Market share gains from competitor supply constraints
analyst_pushback.response: Enough market for all players; focus on distribution: expanding outlets faster than historical pace

tone_evidence: Fully prepared, volumes growing strong, 50% growth feasible, double-digit growth next 5-10 years
